label: Microsoft sign-in — email input (fill)
summary: Email textbox on the Microsoft sign-in page.
note: Primary selector is CSS-based (input[type="email"] / input[name="loginfmt"]) because accessible name varies by tenant; .or() fallback chain used.

label: Microsoft sign-in — email input (read)
summary: Email textbox on the Microsoft sign-in page.
note: Primary selector is CSS-based (input[type="email"] / input[name="loginfmt"]) because accessible name varies by tenant; .or() fallback chain used.

label: Microsoft sign-in — Next button
summary: "Next" button on the Microsoft email step.
note: Falls back to input[type="submit"][value*="Next" i] and a generic submit input via .or() chain for tenants that render the button as <input type="submit">.

label: ADFS — User Account input (fill)
summary: "User Account" textbox on the UCSD ADFS sign-in page.
note: Usually pre-populated by Microsoft via ?username= URL param; still re-filled defensively. Primary is input[name="UserName"]; fallbacks are #userNameInput and getByRole(textbox, {name: /User Account/i}).

label: ADFS — User Account input (read)
summary: "User Account" textbox on the UCSD ADFS sign-in page.
note: Primary is input[name="UserName"]; fallbacks are #userNameInput and getByRole(textbox, {name: /User Account/i}).

label: ADFS — Password input (fill)
summary: "Password" textbox on the ADFS sign-in page.
note: Primary is input[name="Password"]; fallbacks are #passwordInput and getByRole(textbox, {name: /^password$/i}).

label: ADFS — Password input (read)
summary: "Password" textbox on the ADFS sign-in page.
note: Primary is input[name="Password"]; fallbacks are #passwordInput and getByRole(textbox, {name: /^password$/i}).

label: ADFS — Sign in button
summary: "Sign in" submit button on the ADFS sign-in page.
note: Primary is #submitButton; fallback is getByRole(button, {name: /^sign in$/i}).

label: KMSI — No button (Stay signed in? prompt)
summary: "No" button on the "Stay signed in?" / KMSI prompt (login.srf).
note: Always click No; fallbacks are input[type="button"][value="No"] and input[type="submit"][value="No"] via .or() chain.

label: Excel Online — WAC iframe frame locator
summary: Returns the Excel Online FrameLocator scoping iframe[name="WacFrame_Excel_0"] on doc2.aspx.
note: Frame-scoping utility — not a clickable/fillable target itself. Role inferred as read-only container. Every post-auth Excel interaction (ribbon, file menu, workbook body) MUST go through this FrameLocator or selectors resolve to nothing.

label: Excel Online — File ribbon button
summary: File button on the Excel Online ribbon (opens the backstage menu).
note: Must be called with the FrameLocator from getExcelFrame(). exact:true avoids matching "File menu", "File tab", etc.

label: Excel File menu — Create a Copy menuitem
summary: "Create a Copy" menuitem in the File backstage.
note: Must be HOVERED (not clicked) to open the submenu containing Download a Copy. Clicking instead triggers the default action ("Create a copy online"), which navigates away.

label: Excel File menu — Download a Copy menuitem
summary: "Download a Copy" menuitem in the Create a Copy flyout — fires the browser download event for xlsx.
note: Triggering this fires the browser download event. Reached via hover(fileMenu.createACopy) first, not via fileMenu.export (which only offers PDF/CSV/ODS, not xlsx).
